description: End-to-end messages (SPEC.md §10, §11). For each message: fields is the decoded body; body, inner and signedBytes are exact; envelope is HPKE-sealed to the recipient with the ephemeral key DeriveKeyPair(ikmE). Bodies of an unknown kind or notice code are kept as received. rejectedEnvelopes must fail at stage "open" (SPEC.md §10.3 steps 1-4) or "signature" (step 6); rejectedBodies must fail to decode; decisionChecks verify a DECISION against a stored request (§11.6).
